title: New in Symfony 8.2: Redesigned Exception Page
content:
<html><head></head><body>The exception page is probably the Symfony feature that you see most often while
developing applications. Its design has remained almost unchanged for years,
and it showed its age. Symfony 8.2 redesigns the exception page entirely to
help you find the cause…</body></html>
author: Javier Eguiluz
